# MiSA

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

MiSA identifies disease-associated spatial dysbiosis by testing whether the spatial organization of microbial taxa differs between clinical groups, using image-based microbiome data.

## Installation

To install MiSA in R, run:

``` r
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github("liuruoqian/MiSA", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

Load MiSA and see the vignette for a step-by-step guide.

``` r 
library(MiSA)
browseVignettes("MiSA")
```

## Tutorial

Find the MiSA vignette at: [https://liuruoqian.github.io/MiSA/articles/MiSA_vignette.html] for a step-by-step introduction.

See MiSA website: [https://liuruoqian.github.io/MiSA/] for details.
